Marissa — thanks for the recap. Numbers below (ballpark):

1) Average monthly tokens: ~60,000,000 tokens/month (mostly generation + summarization).
2) Peak / burst: expect up to ~5,000,000 tokens in high-traffic hours (spikes typically last ~30–90 minutes, once or twice per day during business launches).
3) Budget range: currently planning for $2k–$3k / month for inference licensing; can stretch for priority features.
4) Target unit economics: ideally ~$25 per 1M tokens to hit ROI targets (we may be willing to accept higher for a short ramp).

A few quick clarifying Qs: 
- Is the base hosted quota typically soft-limited (with automatic throttling) or hard-enforced?
- What are typical overage rates if we exceed quota without a committed amendment?
- Can we request temporary quota increases for predictable launch windows, and how fast can that be approved?

Jordan — great, thanks for the detail. High-level answers and what I can propose: 

- Base quota behavior: hosted plans include a monthly quota tied to the account. Soft limits are applied first (rate limiting and short-term throttling); beyond that, requests are gated. We can provision temporary burst allowances to allow short hourly surges without automatic hard throttling.

- Standard overage rate: for self-serve hosted accounts, our published overage is $30 per 1M tokens. That is what applies if you exceed your quota and do not have a committed amendment.

- Committed overage / reserved option: Given your volumes, Rafael and I can propose a committed overage amendment (or a small reserved capacity block) that would: 
  * Raise your monthly quota to 75M tokens,
  * Provide a guaranteed burst allowance (up to 6M tokens over any 2-hour window) to cover your launch spikes,
  * Reduce the overage rate to $20 per 1M tokens for incremental usage above the committed quota,
  * Include a fast-path for temporary quota increases (we can approve same-day for planned launches once signed).

Attachments: proposed-overage-amendment.pdf

If those terms look promising, Rafael will build the formal amendment and I can route it for a one-click DocuSign. For the pricing math: at 60M tokens/month and target $25 / 1M, the amendment above ($20/1M overage + 75M quota) would put you within target, assuming typical distribution of generation vs summarization. I can run a quick sensitivity if you share more breakdowns (tokens per call, % summarization vs gen).

Availability: I can do a 30-min call tomorrow at 9:30am or 11:00am PT. Which works for you?

Best,
